items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Johnny St. Cyr gave me an invitation.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember Zoo spitting all off that tailgate, yeah. Yeah, he played a many avatars, Zoo Robinson. He was a good, good, good man, good musician.
Johnny St. Cyr gave me an invitation. I mean, spitting everything, and every time he'd spit. Don't you remember Zoo Robinson playing the trombone? I think so.
Was he ratty at all? Huh? Was he ratty at all? Who ratty?
